svg.title: Warm portrait icon
svg.desc: Transparent vector portrait with smooth brown hair, peach skin, a silver hoop earring and an ivory bow blouse. Prepared for Apple Icon Composer. All artwork is editable filled vector paths.
svg.metadata: Source: user-provided Untitled-1.png. Cleanup: built-in image generation, followed by vector tracing. Cleanup prompt: Preserve the same right-facing woman, likeness, hairstyle, hoop earring, ivory bow blouse, and warm brown/peach/cream palette; consolidate fine hair strands into smooth flowing locks; simplify small texture; use a transparent background.
